overall_diagnosis: The build failure is primarily caused by Maven dependency and plugin resolution failing against Maven Central in a legacy OpenJDK7/old Maven environment, producing SSL/TLS transport errors such as "Unrecognized SSL message, plaintext connection?". The recurring gap across diagnoses is insufficient guidance on handling repository/protocol configuration, pluginRepositories, version pinning, and troubleshooting artifact transfer problems under outdated toolchains. A secondary issue is weak coverage of CI goal/lifecycle sequencing around dependency:go-offline and related prefetch steps that can fail early and obscure root causes.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill focuses on dependency declaration and conflict management but lacks practical guidance for diagnosing and repairing dependency resolution failures caused by legacy JDK/Maven TLS incompatibilities and Maven Central transport issues. It undercovers repository/mirror configuration, HTTP vs HTTPS handling in constrained CI environments, settings.xml mirror setup, forcing TLS behavior, and troubleshooting commands for failed artifact transfer.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Add a dedicated troubleshooting section for legacy Maven/JDK repository resolution failures. Cover recognition of errors such as "Unrecognized SSL message, plaintext connection?" and artifact transfer failures; configuring <repositories> and settings.xml mirrors; differences between repo.maven.apache.org and repo1.maven.org; when HTTP mirrors may be temporarily required in isolated CI; forcing TLS versions and using -Dmaven.wagon.http.ssl.* flags; clearing local caches and forcing updates; and diagnostic commands such as mvn -X, dependency:tree, help:effective-settings, and help:effective-pom. Include concrete XML examples and guidance on pinning dependency versions compatible with Java 7-era toolchains.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill does not sufficiently address plugin resolution failures in legacy environments, especially around maven-dependency-plugin and maven-enforcer-plugin retrieval. It lacks coverage of pluginRepositories, plugin version pinning for older Maven/JDK combinations, compatibility constraints, and mitigation strategies for flaky or TLS-incompatible plugin downloads.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Extend the skill with guidance on plugin resolution and compatibility in constrained CI environments. Cover configuring <pluginRepositories> separately from <repositories>, pinning plugin versions through <pluginManagement>, selecting plugin versions compatible with Java 7 and older Maven releases, and handling dependency:go-offline or resolve-plugins failures. Include examples for maven-enforcer-plugin and maven-dependency-plugin, troubleshooting for PluginResolutionException and DependencyResolutionException, and strategies such as temporarily skipping enforcer rules or isolating plugin download steps during bootstrap/debugging.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill lacks guidance on CI lifecycle/goal sequencing issues that amplify repository and TLS failures, particularly around dependency:go-offline, verify, clean ordering, and test skipping semantics. Users may not understand how offline-prefetch goals can fail independently of compilation and testing.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Add a subsection on lifecycle and goal sequencing pitfalls in CI pipelines. Explain how goals like dependency:go-offline and resolve-plugins interact with the lifecycle, why clean should generally precede build/test phases, and how -DskipTests differs from -Dmaven.test.skip. Include recommendations for isolating dependency-prefetch steps from verify/package during troubleshooting and note that offline/prefetch goals can expose repository or TLS incompatibilities before compilation begins.
